description: This file implements a storage interface for the Notesnook project, providing methods for reading, writing, removing, and managing encrypted data using MMKV storage. It defines a KV class and a Storage object with cryptographic functions.

classes.name: KV
classes.description: A class providing key-value storage operations with support for JSON serialization and multi-item handling, built on MMKV storage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value associated with a key, attempting JSON parse if possible.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a value to storage, serializing to JSON if not a string.

methods.name: readMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple keys and returns their values, parsing JSON where applicable.

methods.name: getAllKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys, filtering out internal indices.

methods.name: writeMulti
methods.description: Writes multiple key-value pairs to storage.
